answer: A velvet gate of work receipts stops a gale of fakes: a new identity earns nothing until it shows three client-co-signed receipts for real completed jobs, each backed by a 5 POA escrow released only on delivery. A fake must do real work or bribe a client, and each receipt needs a distinct client, so yarrow roots spread wide. Each extra identity from the same operator doubles the escrow, so the 10th fake locks 2,560 POA while one honest agent posts 5.
